The '''Bubba Blister''' is a {{Legendary}} [[Power Stones|Power Stone]], which unlocks the {{PowerStoneLink|Bubba}} power for [[Accessories]]. The item is {{Rift Exportable}}.

__TOC__

== Obtaining ==
The '''Bubba Blister''' is a {{O|occasional}} drop from the {{Stier|2}} [[Riftstalker Bloodfiend]] or above if the player has {{Coll|Vampire Slayer LVL 3}}.

;Drop Chances
*{{stier|2}}: {{Green|15%}}{{Confirm}}

== Requirements ==
The '''Bubba Blister''' requires {{Skill|combat|XXV}} to be used and can only be used as a Power Stone for [[Accessories]]. Combining 9 '''Bubba Blisters''' at [[Maxwell]] will permanently unlock the '''Bubba''' [[Power Stones|Power]] for [[Accessories]].

== Tips ==
* This power is recommended for [[Wolf Slayer]] due to {{Item|Mastiff Armor}} not having any {{stat|def}}, which is the only downside of this power, and the power granting {{stat|td}} and {{Stat|Combat Wisdom}}.
* While this power also seems good for [[Blaze Slayer]] due to the {{stat|td}} gain, it is not, as while the [[Inferno Demonlord]] does {{stat|Tdmg}}, both {{MobSprite|Quazii}} and {{MobSprite|Typhoeus}} deal massive amount of regular {{stat|dmg}}, which is not reduced by True Defense. However, there are additional ways to get {{stat|Def}} so it could be a viable, yet risky combination.
* This is the only power that grants bonuses to a {{Stat|wisdom}} stat.
